record_title: Sharp A_infinity growth at the weak L1 endpoint for subunit sparse powers
provenance: Sharpness companion to the subunit-power weak L1 endpoint upper bound in Goncalves--Lorist, arXiv:2609.20531, using an explicit nested dyadic weight pair.
limitations: The theorem proves optimal order of the A_infinity exponent for the sparse model itself. It does not give lower bounds for every concrete operator admitting sparse domination, optimize numerical constants, sharpen the mixed A1 factor, or treat the logarithmic r=1 endpoint. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the principal source is very recent and an older implicit reformulation or unindexed contemporaneous observation remains a residual literature risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
